description: This file defines a Retrofit API service interface named ApiService used to communicate with the Trading Journal backend. Currently, it includes a single 'health check' endpoint to verify backend connectivity.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: Interface for defining API endpoints for the Trading Journal backend, with a focus on health check functionality.

methods.name: healthCheck
methods.description: Suspending function that performs a GET request to the root endpoint '/' to verify backend connectivity, returning a Response wrapping a Map with string keys and any type of value.
